title: Best ATS for AI Notetaker Transcripts: Granola, Metaview, and Fireflies Sync (2026)
summary: Do Granola, Metaview, or Fireflies transcripts land on the right candidate profile? Stardex checks which 2026 ATS platforms sync them without copy-paste.
body_markdown:
Recruiters who record calls with Granola, Metaview, or Fireflies face the same problem: the transcript lives in the notetaker, not on the candidate profile. Getting it there usually means copying details into the right record by hand, and for firms running dozens of calls a week, missed entries add up.


This guide compares the applicant tracking systems that sync notetaker transcripts natively against those that still rely on copy-paste or Zapier. It covers Stardex, which has native Granola, Metaview, and Fireflies integrations plus its own AI Notetaker, alongside Loxo, Gem, Bullhorn, Crelate, and Recruiterflow. You’ll find what to look for, a comparison table, our evaluation rubric, and answers to common questions.


## **Why ATS Integrations for AI Notetaker Transcripts Matter**


Most executive search consultants now run candidate and client calls through an AI notetaker. The transcript itself is rarely the problem. Getting it onto the right candidate profile without someone copying and pasting it is where firms lose time and detail.


### **The Need for Notetaker-to-ATS Syncing**


-


**Manual copy-paste risk:** Details such as comp expectations, timing, or reservations about a role can be delayed or never make it into the profile.


-


**Limited native ATS coverage:** Agencies on Bullhorn, JobAdder, or Crelate are often missing from a notetaker’s native integration list, so they fall back on Zapier, custom API work, or copy-paste.


-


**Misattributed transcripts:** Without attendee-based matching, a multi-participant call can land on the wrong candidate or client record.


-


**No searchable call history:** Transcripts stored as static files can’t be searched later when a consultant needs to recall what was discussed.


Native integrations close these gaps by routing transcripts to the correct record at the point of capture and making them searchable alongside the rest of the firm’s candidate data.


## **What to Look for in an ATS for AI Notetaker Transcripts**


The real test isn’t whether an ATS can “connect” to a notetaker. It’s whether a transcript lands on the right candidate or client record automatically, and whether recruiters can find what’s inside it later without re-reading it.

## **How Search Firms and Agencies Sync Notetaker Transcripts Using an ATS**


Firms that already rely on Granola, Metaview, or Fireflies don’t want to give them up to adopt a new ATS. With Stardex, they connect the notetaker they already use and transcripts route to the right candidate profile automatically. Here’s how teams typically set it up.


### **Granola: personal or workspace connection**


-


A recruiter can link their own Granola account so their screening calls sync to the candidate they spoke with.


-


Firms that standardize notetaking can connect a Granola workspace, so intake calls, screens, and reference checks from every consultant land on the correct profile.


-


On split desks, the researcher who sourced a candidate and the consultant who screened them see the same transcript history.


### **Metaview: interview data that fills in the record**


-


Interview transcripts autofill structured scorecards.


-


Profile fields such as name, job title, stage, location, and CV can be enriched from the interview data Metaview captures.


### **Fireflies: enterprise-wide or individual sync**


-


Call summaries appear alongside a candidate’s full history.


-


Enterprise-wide connections sync every Fireflies call across the team without each consultant configuring their own link.


### **Other notetakers: Zapier plus AI matching**


-


For notetakers without a native integration, a Zapier connection routes the transcript into Stardex and AI matching finds the correct candidate record from attendee and call metadata.


-


The same attendee-matched approach applies to Zoom Transcripts.


### **Stardex AI Notetaker: built in**


-


Firms without a dedicated notetaker can run Stardex’s AI Notetaker on Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams calls.


-


Semantic search then runs across transcripts, notes, and email history together, so a candidate assessed months ago can resurface when what they said matches a new brief.


Across all five setups, the notetaker is the firm’s choice, not the vendor’s.[Book a demo with Stardex](https://www.stardex.com/book-demo) to see how your current notetaker stack would sync.

## **Best ATS for AI Notetaker Transcripts in 2026**


### **1. Stardex**


Stardex is an AI-native ATS and CRM built for executive search firms. It connects natively with Granola, Metaview, and Fireflies and also offers its own AI Notetaker for Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams.


**Key Features:** Native Granola, Metaview, and Fireflies integrations; built-in AI Notetaker; semantic search across transcripts, notes, and profiles; open API, Zapier, and MCP server.


**Candidate Workflow Offerings:** Call notes attach automatically to the matching candidate profile; full transcripts are searchable; Metaview autofills interview scorecards; Fireflies can sync firm-wide.


**Pricing:** Starter at $79/user/month, Pro at $119/user/month, and a custom Copilot plan that includes a branded AI Notetaker.

**Cons:** Firms get the most value after admin setup, such as rules for which calls the AI Notetaker joins and which calendars it monitors.


### **2. Loxo**


Loxo ships its own AI Notetaker, which auto-syncs the transcript, summary, recording, and key snippets to the candidate record after a call.


**Key Features:** Proprietary, in-house AI Notetaker.


**Pricing:** Not publicly disclosed; confirm with Loxo.


**Pros:** Keeps call data in one system.


**Cons:** Transcript data can take roughly two hours to appear, and firms can’t bring Granola, Metaview, or Fireflies into the workflow.


### **3. Gem**


Gem connects to Metaview and BrightHire through its ATS Ecosystem for automatic recording, transcription, and sync. Since January 2026, the Metaview connection also autofills interview scorecards.


**Key Features:** ATS Ecosystem integrations with Metaview and BrightHire.


**Pricing:** Not publicly disclosed; confirm with Gem.


**Pros:** No tab-switching between the notetaker and the ATS to fill out scorecards.


**Cons:** The Metaview connection is limited to Gem ATS customers; CRM-only teams are excluded.


### **4. Bullhorn**


Bullhorn uses its own Amplify Transcribe and Live Transcribe tools, which save a call summary, a Q&A view, and the full transcript as a note on the record, via a meeting bot or, in Early Access, bot-free.


**Key Features:** Native Amplify Transcribe and Live Transcribe.


**Pricing:** Not publicly disclosed; confirm with Bullhorn.


**Pros:** No separate notetaker vendor to manage.


**Cons:** Third-party notetakers such as Fireflies aren’t listed as native integrations.


### **5. Crelate**


Crelate connects to Granola, Fireflies, and other notetakers through Zapier workflows rather than a pre-built sync.


**Key Features:** Zapier integration framework.


**Pricing:** Not publicly disclosed; confirm with Crelate.


**Pros:** Zapier opens access to hundreds of other tools.


**Cons:** No native, attendee-matched sync; firms build and maintain the Zapier workflow themselves.


### **6. Recruiterflow**


Recruiterflow lists Granola among its Zapier-connected integrations, grouped with tools like Calendly and RingCentral rather than offered as a dedicated transcript sync.


**Key Features:** Zapier-based integrations.


**Pricing:** Not publicly disclosed; confirm with Recruiterflow.


**Pros:** Broad access to the Zapier app catalog.


**Cons:** A general automation workaround rather than a purpose-built transcript sync.

## **FAQs About ATS Integrations for AI Notetaker Transcripts**


### **Which ATS automatically syncs Granola transcripts to the right candidate profile?**


Stardex connects to Granola through a personal or workspace account and routes each transcript to the matching candidate record automatically. It matches on attendee email first and falls back to name matching when no email is available.


### **Does Metaview integrate natively with an ATS for agencies and executive search firms?**


Yes. Stardex connects directly to Metaview with no third-party automation layer, and the integration is listed in Metaview’s help center. Transcripts and summaries attach to candidate profiles, and interview data can autofill scorecards.


### **Can Fireflies.ai send meeting transcripts directly into an ATS candidate record?**


Yes. Stardex supports Fireflies through enterprise-wide or individual connections and matches transcripts to candidate records by call attendees. The enterprise-wide option avoids setting up the connection one recruiter at a time.


### **What’s the difference between a native notetaker integration and a Zapier workaround?**


A native integration syncs transcripts straight into candidate records with attendee-based matching built in. With Zapier, as Crelate and Recruiterflow use, the firm builds and maintains its own triggers and field mappings.


### **Why does Stardex support Granola, Metaview, Fireflies, and its own AI Notetaker instead of building one in-house tool?**


Stardex connects to strong third-party tools rather than forcing recruiters onto a single in-house option. Firms that prefer a built-in notetaker can use Stardex’s AI Notetaker for Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams.


### **How does transcript-to-candidate matching work when multiple people attend the same call?**


Stardex attaches the transcript to any attendee whose email matches a record, then falls back to name matching. For Zapier-based workflows, an AI closest-match step links the transcript to the most likely candidate record.
